events.title: Climate Builders #3
facts: budget
55 people got through 14 pizzas from Slice & Co (GBP 133) and 40 coffees from Bean There (GBP 112).
venue
Canary Wharf Tech Hub is free for communities but security needs the guest list 48 hours ahead; 8 walk-ins were turned away.
lesson
Send the guest list to Canary Wharf security on Tuesday for a Thursday event.
budget
Northwind Cloud paid GBP 1,500 for logo placement and a 5 minute slot; invoice paid in 21 days.

events.title: Women in AI Breakfast
facts: budget
30 person breakfast: Crumbs Vegan pastries and fruit GBP 330, coffee cart GBP 84, room GBP 280.
venue
Clerkenwell Coworking Studio has no kitchen; caterers must deliver ready to serve by 07:45.
voice
Breakfast events fill fastest when the post leads with the speaker, not the food.
budget
Ledgerly sponsored GBP 600 and asked for a photo of the banner for their newsletter.

events.title: LLM Hack Night
facts: budget
90 hackers ate 26 pizzas (GBP 247) and drank GBP 585 of soft drinks and beer over 6 hours.
budget
Total spend GBP 2,630 against GBP 2,800 sponsorship: Northwind 2,000, Fennel 800, Quill gave swag.
lesson
Book Lumen AV a week ahead; the Southbank projector does not take HDMI-C.
volunteer
Five volunteers covered a 6 hour hackathon; one dedicated to judging logistics saved the close.

events.title: Founder Fireside: Fundraising in 2026
facts: budget
70 people, hall hire GBP 350, coffee GBP 196, printed programmes GBP 64 from Thames Print Studio.
venue
King's Cross Library Hall bans alcohol; plan a coffee-and-cake format instead.
lesson
Fireside talks need a roving mic; questions from the back were inaudible without one.
budget
Fennel Ventures paid GBP 1,000 to host the fireside and asked for the attendee count by email.

events.title: Autumn Community Social
facts: budget
100 guests: drinks GBP 650 (2 per head), 25 pizzas GBP 237, venue GBP 600.
venue
Brixton Warehouse Taproom is echoey; hire two handheld mics for any speeches.
voice
Social posts with a photo of last time's crowd got twice the sign-ups of text-only posts.
lesson
Pre-order 20% vegetarian pizza; vegetarian ran out first again.
